boundary.zh: Open Exchange Rates 官方 v0.7 JSON REST API，覆盖 latest、historical、currencies、time-series、convert、OHLC 与 usage 七个只读 Endpoint 及官方附加查询参数。
boundary.en: The official Open Exchange Rates v0.7 JSON REST API covering the seven read-only latest, historical, currencies, time-series, convert, OHLC, and usage endpoints plus officially documented query parameters.

derivedProbeFixes: normalized the ReadMe colon date path to an OpenAPI path template
replaced six hyphenated operationIds with code-generation-safe identifiers
removed the generated dangling schemas import because the official OAS declares zero component schemas

blockers.zh: 网站条款保留站点与文档知识产权，只授予不可转让、可撤销的有限使用权；官方 Node wrapper 仓库也没有可识别 LICENSE。尚无证据允许 Pontx 再分发规范 prose 或发布独立生成 SDK。
blockers.en: The website terms reserve site and documentation intellectual property and grant only a non-transferable, revocable, limited right of use; the official Node wrapper repository also has no identifiable LICENSE. No evidence yet authorizes Pontx to redistribute specification prose or publish an independently generated SDK.

blockers.zh: 已从官方 ReadMe 页面内嵌的 document.api.schema 机械提取 7-Endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 快照并固定 SHA-256，但源 URL 可变且契约质量未达门槛：0 个 component Schema、4 个成功响应无 Schema、2 个 Endpoint 无 4xx/default、1 个 path template 不合法、6 个 operationId 含连字符而无法直接生成 TypeScript，并且 7 个 Endpoint 均无 Pontx 成功请求示例。
blockers.en: A seven-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 snapshot was mechanically extracted from document.api.schema on the official ReadMe page and pinned by SHA-256, but the source URL is mutable and the contract fails quality gates: zero component schemas, four successful responses without schemas, two endpoints without 4xx/default responses, one invalid path template, six hyphenated operationIds that cannot directly generate TypeScript, and no Pontx successful request example on any endpoint.

blockers.zh: 数据套餐限制基准货币、更新频率、历史/高级能力与再分发权；Hub 代理默认应关闭，调用方必须直接使用自己的 App ID 与数据许可。
blockers.en: Plan entitlements govern base currencies, refresh frequency, historical/advanced features, and redistribution rights; Hub proxying should stay disabled and callers must use their own App ID and data license directly.

blockers.zh: 隔离 RC 在修正 path、6 个 operationId 和生成器空 Schema import 后，可生成 7 个 Endpoint 并通过 TypeScript、ESM/CJS/declarations、CLI build、npm pack dry-run；匿名 currencies SDK/CLI 实调返回 173 种货币。但 0 个 Schema 和三项派生补丁证明它不是可发布 SDK，且尚无独立仓库、CI 或 npm 版本。
blockers.en: After derived fixes for the path, six operationIds, and the generator's empty-schema import, an isolated RC generates seven endpoints and passes TypeScript, ESM/CJS/declarations, CLI build, npm pack dry-run, and anonymous SDK/CLI calls returning 173 currencies. Zero schemas and three derived patches demonstrate that it is not publishable, and no independent repository, CI evidence, or npm version exists.

nextAction.zh: 向 Open Exchange Rates 获取可再分发的固定 OAS 与生成客户端书面许可；许可通过后逐 Endpoint 补齐套餐条件、错误 Schema、成功请求示例并以代理关闭模式发布 SDK/CLI。
nextAction.en: Obtain a redistributable pinned OAS and written generated-client permission from Open Exchange Rates; after approval, complete endpoint-level plan conditions, error schemas, and successful request examples, then publish the SDK/CLI with proxying disabled.
